description: Election Commission - Provincial Councils Elections Act No. 02 of 1988 - filling of a vacancy in the Central Provincial Council Mr. H. R. Ranasinghe as a member
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Central Province Provincial Council due to the death of a member. It details the electoral process under the Provincial Councils Elections Act, including the nomination of a replacement candidate by a political party and the formal declaration of election by the Election Commission. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters, making it a Type 7 (Elections) classification.
